interpretation_rules: Keep pressure in dbar. Do not silently label810dbar as810m. Any later metre conversion needs an explicit operator and declared latitude for this section-averaged quantity.

810dbar and480dbar are sign reversals of mean section velocity, not mean instantaneous boundaries or full current thicknesses. A cross-section average can conceal opposing flows; it is not a current-axis point.

690dbar is conditional on source southward-component selection excluding LP recirculation. It does not replace480dbar as the all-times mean and the two values do not form a seasonal or uncertainty range. Exact selection/reaveraging algorithm not independently reconstructed.
Source transport integration uses810dbar offshore and690dbar LP. Those fixed limits are not monthly boundary observations. Seasonal transport table cannot supply a seasonal depth curve.

PIES bottom pressures and assumed no-motion reference levels are distinct from velocity reversal. Intermediate water-mass boundaries and the150m temperature seasonal-correction limit are also distinct quantities.
Meddy passage around PIES D in April2023 affects both offshore segments. Do not remove it without an explicit alternate-case definition.

Source GEM uses10dbar pressure spacing, historical CTD/Argo lookup tables, seasonal corrections, calibration, absolute reference velocities and bottom-pressure anomalies. Nominal pressure resolution is not depth uncertainty.

archive_assessment.title: PIES data collected north of the Canary Islands
archive_assessment.metadata_described_content: Encoded acoustic travel time and bottom pressure telemetry; MSB/LSB reconstruction required. Archive prose names original .dat files while actual published keys are *_revised.txt.
archive_assessment.next_processing_dependency: Identify a published derived absolute-velocity product or document and reproduce the GEM/reference-velocity pipeline in cloud before calculating dated or seasonal reversal pressures. Five raw telemetry files alone are not a ready velocity-depth product.
